# QR Gear

> Physical gear. Digital world. Custom merchandise with QR codes connecting to a link, image, video or changing digital experience.

Current prices, options and availability come from the live product pages and checkout. Production and shipping estimates vary by item and destination.

## QR types

- [QR Basics](https://qrgear.com/qr-basics): A simple, scannable QR code. Text, URL, or contact info encoded permanently. No updates. No subscriptions.
- [QR Plus](https://qrgear.com/qr-plus): Add a message above and below your QR. Perfect for calls-to-action and instructions. Printed once. Works forever.
- [QR Canvas](https://qrgear.com/qr-canvas): Design a custom image your QR opens to. Your QR Space. Your visual. Saved to your personal library.
- [QR Play](https://qrgear.com/qr-play): Bring your QR to life with video. Plays instantly in your QR Space. No apps. Just scan.
- [QR Dynamics™](https://qrgear.com/qr-dynamics): Content that changes over time. Scheduled updates, rotating content, analytics. Available as yearly or multi-year personal QR Spaces.
